title: Equilibrium and Welfare in Markets with Financially Constrained Arbitrageurs (indexed as: Liquidity and Market Crashes / Leverage Cycle)
one_line: Theory: margin-constrained arbitrageurs under-provide liquidity; after losses they must cut positions, which widens mispricings exactly when capital is scarce.
